tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Singapore's financial sector has new guidance. Confirmed by The Business Times: MAS rolls out AI risk management guidelines effective Oct 7, 2027.
A flaw in GitHub Copilot CLI exposes developer secrets through encrypted prompt injection. Reported by GBHackers News: attackers can steal secrets in 28 seconds.
Anthropic expands access to its most powerful models for security testing. Confirmed by ET BrandEquity: teams with critical infrastructure access can now use them.
The Department of Defense halts use of Anthropic AI following a court decision. Reported by Homeland Security Today: the supply chain risk designation has been upheld.
Trump rejects joint ventures between US and Chinese companies on artificial intelligence. Reported by MediaNama: he announces a voluntary tech industry artificial intelligence safety pact.
Free every hour.
